Loose end track

Source: R/geom-loose-end.R
geom_loose_end.Rd

Draws loose ends, breakpoints with copy number change but no junction partner as inferred by JaBbA, as a short stem topped with an open circle. x defaults to the start column. Map y to the copy number at each loose end, e.g. from loose_end_copy_number(), to place them on a copy number track; otherwise they sit at the bottom of the panel.

Usage

geom_loose_end(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  stem_height = 3,
  ...,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

Arguments

mapping

Set of aesthetic mappings created by ggplot2::aes().

data

Data frame of loose ends with seqnames and start columns, e.g. a JaBbA loose_ends.bed.

stem_height

Height of the stems in mm, default: 3

...

Other arguments passed to ggplot2::layer(), e.g. colour or linewidth.

na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

See ggplot2::layer().

Value

ggplot2 layer

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
loose <- data.table::fread("sample.jabba.phased.loose_ends.bed",
                           col.names = c("seqnames", "start", "end"))

ggplot2::ggplot() +
  geom_copy_number(data = cn) +
  geom_loose_end(data = loose_end_copy_number(loose, cn), ggplot2::aes(y = cn)) +
  coord_genome() +
  theme_genomic()
} # }
